meta.title: H. Remigiuskerk in Duiven
meta.description: Activities at the H. Remigiuskerk in Duiven, of the parish of Saint Thomas the Apostle for Chaldeans in the Netherlands.

header.parish: Saint Thomas the Apostle, parish for Chaldeans in the Netherlands

empty.title: Nothing is on the agenda yet
empty.body: There are no activities at the moment. You are welcome to look again later. When there is something to come to, it will be here.

event.heroAlt: People walking toward a church with light in the windows

signup.title: Sign up
signup.intro: Tell us who is coming. After payment you receive the tickets by email. Each ticket has its own number and barcode.
signup.emailHint: We send the tickets and news about this activity here.
signup.bingoHint: Five winners. It starts with a Christmas gift of about €30. On the day you follow the numbers on your phone and cross them off your card. You can also buy a card at the door.
signup.simulated: On this computer, payment is simulated until Stripe is connected.
signup.paymentsClosed: Payment is not open yet. Please try again later.

errors.email: Enter an email address we can write to.
errors.age: Enter an age for each person.
errors.event: This activity is no longer open.
errors.payment: Payment did not work. Please try again later.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

complete.title: Payment received
complete.waiting: The bank has not confirmed the payment yet. This page refreshes by itself.
complete.body: These are your ticket numbers. We also send them to {email}.
complete.emailPending: The email has not been sent yet. Keep this page, or open your tickets with the button below.

ticket.title: Your ticket
ticket.intro: Enter the ticket number. That number is also in your email.
ticket.invalid: That number does not belong to this signup.
ticket.barcodeHint: Keep this screen ready at the entrance.
ticket.prize: This ticket has won one of the five prizes.
ticket.bingoPrize: This ticket has won one of the five bingo prizes.
ticket.calledEmpty: The first number will appear here.
ticket.pending: This signup is not paid yet.
